   - Private deployment options (VPC + on-prem connector)
   - Live latency sample with 512 tokens + edge routing scenario
   - Observability: console traces + token-level cost view

2) Prebrief schedule (12/7) — 08:45–09:00 PST (15m)
   - 08:45 Intro and confirm success criteria (Dylan + Elena)
   - 08:50 Quick run-through of demo script (Laura)
   - 08:57 Q&A / last-minute logistics

We will plan for a 40m demo following the prebrief (09:30–10:10). If procurement wants to run through the security checklist earlier, happy to set a separate time.

Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
